question: Queue 20261030-1744-expand-storage-1b93-u01-q04: self_hosted is proposed true for storage/cubbit-ds3-composer. Should dossier/README's self_hosted definition say outright that a vendor-run control plane whose workers are the storage itself (Cubbit's Coordinator and the user's storage agents) is self-hosted, unlike a hosted control plane whose workers only run the user's code?
why: The README's hosted clause names a hosted control plane whose workers the user deploys; for Composer the user-run nodes are the capacity the 3 TB licence is spent on and the Cubbit-run Coordinator holds no user data, so the record is set true under the first sentence of the definition. A one-line clarification would settle similar records.
